verdict.rationale: Wally Cloud runs cloud models on RunAnywhere's hardware rather than the user's, so models too large for a laptop can be used with the same tools (docs-13). A `--cloud` flag requests the hosted model instead of a local one (docs-16), and there is also an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (docs-4), browser sign-in (docs-5, docs-15) and usage tracking (docs-11). Hosted versus local is an explicit user choice, not a silent switch (docs-10, docs-35), which fits a power-user deciding when local hardware falls short. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the cloud tier, a documented catalog of which large models are hosted, and an explicit statement that no local download is required.
